merge-pdf.title: Merge PDFs
merge-pdf.shortDesc: Combine 2 or more PDFs into a single document, in the order you choose.
merge-pdf.lead: Drag your PDFs in the order you want them combined. They're stitched into a single PDF you can download in seconds. Works on any number of files up to 100 MB total.

ui.uploadCta: Drop PDFs here, or click to choose

steps.p: Drop multiple PDFs onto the upload area or click to browse. The order you add them is the order they'll be merged in.
Drag the file cards to change order. Remove any file you didn't mean to add.
We process server-side and stream back a single PDF. Files auto-delete from our servers within an hour.
Open the merged PDF, verify the page order, save it to disk.

useCases: Combine multiple bank statements into one annual file before tax season.
Stitch a cover letter, CV, and portfolio into a single application packet.
Merge separate scan files of a multi-page form before submitting.
Bundle vendor invoices for a single month into one accounting document.

faq.a: Yes — files are merged in the exact order shown in the editor. Drag-and-drop to rearrange before clicking Merge.
Page-level content, links, and form fields carry over. Top-level bookmarks from the first PDF are preserved; bookmarks from subsequent PDFs are merged in below.

faq.q: Is there a file count limit?
faq.a: 20 files per merge, 100 MB total. If you need more, merge in batches and combine the result.
Files are auto-deleted within one hour. We never share, train on, or look at the contents.

split-pdf.title: Split PDF
split-pdf.shortDesc: Break a PDF into separate files — every page, every N pages, or at chosen page numbers.
split-pdf.lead: Split a PDF into individual pages, fixed-size chunks, or custom page ranges. Get back a zip with each part as its own PDF.

ui.uploadCta: Drop a PDF here, or click to choose

steps.p: Drop a single PDF onto the upload area.
Every page (one PDF per page), every N pages (fixed chunks), or specific split points.
We slice it server-side and bundle the parts into a zip.
Inside is one PDF per part, named in page order.

useCases: Extract a single chapter from an ebook or report.
Split a 200-page contract into per-section PDFs for routing.
Send only one statement out of an annual bank PDF.
Split a presentation into per-slide files for sharing.

faq.a: If N=3 on a 12-page PDF, you get 4 files: pages 1-3, 4-6, 7-9, 10-12.
Specify the first page of each new chunk. e.g., 4,7 on a 10-page PDF = files for pages 1-3, 4-6, 7-10.
Browsers don't trigger multiple PDF downloads at once. A zip lets you save all parts in a single click.

remove-pages-pdf.title: Remove pages
remove-pages-pdf.shortDesc: Delete specific pages from a PDF — type the pages or ranges to drop.
remove-pages-pdf.h1: Remove Pages from a PDF — Free
remove-pages-pdf.lead: Type the pages you want to drop using ranges (e.g. 1,3-5,9) and we'll write a new PDF without them.

ui.uploadCta: Drop a PDF here, or click to choose

steps.p: We show the page count once it's loaded.
Comma-separated, ranges allowed. Examples: 2, 1,3,5, 4-7, 1,3-5,9.
We rebuild the PDF without those pages and send it back.
Verify the result — page numbering and bookmarks are renumbered automatically.

useCases: Drop blank dividers, cover sheets, or appendices before sharing.
Remove an internal-only page before sending the PDF to a client.
Strip out the marketing pages from a scanned report.
Delete a wrong scan from a multi-page form.

faq.q: Can I keep pages instead of removing?
faq.a: We invert your selection internally. To keep only pages 2 and 4 of an 8-page PDF, remove 1,3,5-8.
Bookmarks pointing to removed pages are dropped; others are preserved with new page numbers.
It scales — typing 'remove pages 5-200' beats clicking each one. Same syntax used by pdfcpu and most PDF CLIs.

remove-empty-pages.title: Remove empty pages
remove-empty-pages.shortDesc: Auto-detect and drop blank pages from a scan or generated PDF.
remove-empty-pages.h1: Remove Blank Pages from a PDF — Free
remove-empty-pages.lead: Common in scans (back of one-sided documents) and report generators (page-break artefacts). We render every page, detect 99%+ white pages with no extractable text, and rebuild the PDF without them.

ui.uploadCta: Drop a PDF here, or click to choose

steps.p: Drop the PDF that has blank pages mixed in.
We render every page and check it for content.
We tell you which page numbers were dropped before you download — no surprises.
The cleaned PDF, blanks gone, page numbers renumbered.

useCases: Clean up a duplex scan where every other page is empty.
Trim auto-generated reports that have stray blank divider pages.
Pre-process a PDF before printing to save paper.

faq.a: Two checks: pdftotext extracts no readable text from the page, AND ≥99% of rendered pixels are within 5 luminance points of pure white.

faq.q: Will it remove pages with just a logo or watermark?
faq.a: Probably not — the watermark fails the 99% white threshold. If you have a near-blank page that you DO want removed, use Remove pages with a manual selection.

faq.q: What if every page looks blank?
faq.a: We refuse to save an empty file and return an error. Likely your PDF is image-only with content; try a different tool.

rotate-pdf.title: Rotate PDF
rotate-pdf.shortDesc: Rotate all pages or selected pages by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
rotate-pdf.lead: Phone scans often come out sideways. Rotate the whole PDF or just the offending pages and download the corrected file.

ui.uploadCta: Drop a PDF here, or click to choose

steps.p: Drop in your sideways PDF.
90° clockwise, 180°, or 90° counter-clockwise (270°). Optionally limit to specific page ranges.
We apply the rotation server-side.
Open it — it should view in the right orientation everywhere.

useCases: Fix a scanner that fed pages sideways.
Rotate landscape charts in a portrait report so they print correctly.
Flip a 180° upside-down scan.

faq.q: Does this rotate the page or the content?
faq.a: It sets the PDF page rotation flag, which is what every viewer respects. The content is untouched and re-rotates correctly when you copy text out.

faq.q: Can I rotate different pages by different amounts?
faq.a: Run the tool once per angle. Each pass overwrites the previous rotation flag for the pages you select.

compress-pdf.title: Compress PDF
compress-pdf.shortDesc: Reduce PDF file size by deduplicating resources and re-encoding streams.
compress-pdf.lead: Shrink large PDFs to email-friendly sizes. We dedupe shared resources, re-encode content streams, and remove unreferenced objects. Typical gains: 5–30% on text-heavy PDFs.

ui.uploadCta: Drop a PDF here, or click to choose

steps.p: Drop the bloated PDF.
We optimise on the server.
We tell you the original size vs the compressed size before you download.
Identical visuals, smaller file.

useCases: Email a 20 MB PDF that bounced your client's 10 MB inbox limit.
Speed up uploading large reports to a CMS.
Reduce storage cost for long-archived PDFs.
Make a PDF small enough to upload to a job application portal.

faq.a: No — this is a lossless pass. We don't re-encode images at lower resolution. If you need aggressive image-level compression for a 100 MB scan, you'll need a separate image-aware tool.

faq.q: Why didn't my PDF shrink much?
faq.a: If it was already optimised (most modern PDFs are) the gain is small. Image-heavy PDFs especially have less room — the bytes are mostly in JPEG/PNG streams that are already compressed.
Yes. Open the original and the compressed version side-by-side — pages should be pixel-identical.
